data.title: 管理员 · 周末露台替你留一把椅子
data.description: 周末露台咖啡店，管理员换上石墨短夹克与奶油白直筒裤，露出面部。她站在圆桌旁替你拉开椅子，回头笑着招呼；两杯饮料与一份共享蛋糕摆在桌上，栏边绿植轻轻晃动。
data.action: 拉开空椅子，露出面部回头迎接镜头
data.lighting: 露台遮阳伞下明亮柔光
data.promptProse: The Administrator stands beside a round terrace-cafe table, pulling a chair out for the viewer and smiling with her face uncovered. Her graphite cropped jacket and cream trousers remain clear in the eye-level cowboy view. Two drinks and shared cake sit between the chairs; railing plants move behind. Bright light softened by the parasol touches her ivory top and chair back, with gentle plant shadows at the terrace edge.
